subject: math
description: Solve multi-step angle problems involving parallel lines, perpendicular lines, transversals, and organized written reasoning.
learningObjectives: Identify angle relationships in diagrams with parallel and perpendicular lines
Use vertical, linear pair, supplementary, corresponding, alternate interior, and same-side interior relationships
Apply perpendicular-line facts to find right angles and connected missing measures
Solve multi-step missing-angle problems involving transversals
Write organized reasoning that justifies each angle measure
prerequisites: Name and measure angles from diagrams
Identify vertical angles, adjacent angles, linear pairs, and supplementary angles
Recognize corresponding, alternate interior, alternate exterior, and same-side interior angles
Know that perpendicular lines form four right angles
